items.description: Resolved review evidence can validate while recorded findings remain actionable.
items.evidence: src/specle/lifecycle.py:_validate_record accepts review.status resolved for approved state without inspecting review-findings.json.
items.analysis: The repair accepts the lifecycle outcome produced by resolve, but the validator must also confirm that every recorded review finding has a terminal decision before treating resolved evidence as eligible for commit.
items.recommendation: Validate review-findings.json for an approved resolved review and reject missing, unreadable, or unsettled findings.
